findings.claim: The required component test for Select keyboard selection is missing.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criterion 3.2 requires "Add component tests for the ui-primitives spec (dialog focus trap/Escape/focus return, select keyboard selection, tooltip on focus, switch Space, collapsible expanded state)"; the added primitives.test.tsx contains describe blocks for Dialog, Tooltip, Switch, and Collapsible only, with no Select test.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a Testing Library/Vitest component test that renders the Select primitive, opens it via keyboard, navigates with arrow keys, selects with Enter, and asserts the selected value is reported.

findings.claim: The Sheet primitive was deleted even though the added ui-primitives requirement explicitly covers sheets.
findings.evidence: openspec/changes/shadcn-base-ui-migration/specs/ui-primitives/spec.md says "Dialogs and sheets SHALL move focus inside when opened, keep Tab focus inside while open, close on Escape and on a pointer press outside, and return focus to the element that opened them"; the diff deletes src/components/ui/sheet.tsx with no replacement.
findings.suggested_fix: Keep or add a Base UI-backed Sheet component and tests satisfying the same overlay behavior, or remove/adjust the sheet requirement from the accepted spec if sheets are intentionally out of scope.
